discover.title: Found Control4 audio devices
discover.description: Only Control4 amps are listed. Sony, WiiM, and other SDDP gear is ignored. If your chassis is missing, choose Enter IP address manually.

user.title: Control4 Audio
user.description: IP address and hardware type for this amp. Inputs are next, then zones.

inputs.title: Name inputs
inputs.description: You are naming INPUT jacks. Leave a box empty to skip that input. Named inputs become the source list on each amp zone.

outputs.title: Name zones
outputs.description: You are naming speaker zones. Leave a name empty to skip that zone. Choose a room for each named zone. Turn-on volume is optional; empty uses the amp's turn-on volume.

confirm.title: Control4 amp found
confirm.description: {model} at {host}. Give it a name, then name its inputs and zones.

reconfigure.title: Change the address
reconfigure.description: Use this when the amp has a new IP address. Entities and settings are kept.

error.cannot_connect: No UDP reply on port 8750. Check the IP and that Director is not blocking the chassis.
error.not_an_amp: That device answered, but not as a Control4 amp. The audio switch is not supported.

abort.already_configured: That device is already set up.
abort.not_audio_chassis: That Control4 device is not an amp.
abort.wrong_device: A different Control4 amp answered at that address.

abort.not_an_amp: This entry is not a supported amp. Delete it.

init.title: Configure Control4 Audio
init.description: Name inputs and zones here. Volume, polling, and timeout are under Settings.

inputs.title: Name inputs
inputs.description: You are naming INPUT jacks. Leave a box empty to skip that input. Named inputs become the source list on each amp zone.

outputs.title: Name zones
outputs.description: You are naming speaker zones. Leave a name empty to skip that zone. Choose a room for each named zone. Turn-on volume is optional; empty uses the amp's turn-on volume.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Amp default turn-on volume is 10% so rooms do not come on loud. Maximum volume is a software cap.

data.active_poll_interval: Status poll interval while a zone is on (seconds)
data.remember_source: Turn zones on with their last source

data_description.remember_source: Off: zones always turn on with the first named input.
data_description.experimental_controls: The commands are not confirmed on every amp. Each change is read back, and an amp that ignores it reports an error.

send_command.name: Send UDP command
send_command.description: Send a raw Control4 serial-over-UDP body.

set_route.name: Set route
set_route.description: Route one output to an input on a chassis.

turn_off_all.name: Turn off all zones
turn_off_all.description: Mute and disconnect enabled amp zones. Leave the amp empty for every amp.

turn_on_all.name: Turn on all zones
turn_on_all.description: Turn on enabled amp zones that are off. Already-on rooms keep volume. Leave the amp empty for every amp.
